text:
alice.chen: :rotating_light: hitting GPU autoscaler alerts — queue depth on inference-pool spiking, pods saturated, HPA not scaling up

raj.patel: saw a stack of 120 pending requests in queue for /generate, 95% latency increase, a bunch of 429s from the API gateway

maya.roberts: metrics-adapter showing timeouts to Prometheus earlier, got multiple 504s in adapter logs around 00:12 UTC

incident-bot: Paging oncall-sre (severity P1) — GPU capacity exhausted, autoscaler not reacting (HPA target unavailable).

oncall-sre: I'm oncall, taking incident. Can someone paste the HPA status and metrics-adapter logs?

dan.infra: hpa status: 
```
kubectl get hpa inference-gpu -n redwood
NAME            REFERENCE            TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
inference-gpu   Deployment/inference 0.0%/80%  2         50        2          3h
```
adapter logs: multiple lines like 
```
E0100 00:12:10.123 adapter.go:178] failed to fetch metrics: GET /api/v1/query?query=... timed out
E0100 00:12:10.124 adapter.go:179] upstream Prometheus 504
```

lina-customerops: customers A and B reported increased error rates, some dropped requests to our hosted endpoints. Customer support is fielding two urgent tickets.

alice.chen: immediate mitigation idea: temporarily increase HPA.maxReplicas and manually scale deployment to relieve queue while we fix metrics flow. Also consider throttling low-priority queues.

raj.patel: agreed. Manual scale to 20 replicas now? we have quota but cost ok for emergency. Patch HPA to max 200 to unblock autoscaler when metrics come back.

oncall-sre: doing manual scale: `kubectl scale deploy inference --replicas=20 -n redwood` and patch HPA maxReplicas to 200. Running now.

deploy-bot: Command accepted. Scaling deployment inference to 20 replicas. Rolling update started.

maya.roberts: after scale started, queue drained partially — pending dropped from 120 -> 30 in 6m. Latency improving. Still seeing adapter timeouts.

dan.infra: investigating why metrics-adapter timed out: Prometheus ingestion backlog spiking, memory OOM killer on prometheus-01 earlier. Restarted prometheus-01 at 00:20 UTC; it came back but backlog ~2h of scrape samples.

oncall-sre: that explains missing HPA metrics. Need to restore prom ingest and restart metrics-adapter and metrics-server to repopulate HPA targets.

alice.chen: plan: 1) keep manual scaled replicas until autoscaler healthy, 2) restart metrics-adapter deployment, 3) restart kube-metrics-server, 4) monitor HPA target metrics.

raj.patel: restarting adapter now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment metrics-adapter -n kube-system`

deploy-bot: Rollout of metrics-adapter started.

maya.roberts: metrics-adapter pods came up, now returning metrics, but still limited throughput to Prom due to TSDB compaction. HPA is seeing metrics again but needs couple minutes to converge.

oncall-sre: HPA reported targets: CPU 40%/80%, custom_gpu_queue 65%/80%. Triggered horizontal scale to 40 replicas.

dan.infra: observed autoscaler backfill: HPA increased replicas to 40 over 9 minutes. Queue now down to 2. No more new 429s reported from gateway.

lina-customerops: confirmed with customers A and B that error rates have returned to normal; they want a postmortem and ETA for root cause fix.

alice.chen: root cause summary (initial): Prometheus node OOM -> prolonged TSDB backlog -> metrics-adapter timed out -> HPA missing custom metrics -> no autoscale -> GPU pool exhausted under sustained load. Secondary: HPA.maxReplicas too low for sudden surge.

oncall-sre: mitigation actions logged: increased HPA.maxReplicas from 50->200, manual scale to 20->40, restarted prometheus and metrics-adapter, validated HPA metric supply. Will monitor for 2 hours.

maya.roberts: creating incident issue and assigning to eng-ml for autoscaler hardening (add fallback to queue-length local estimation) and infra for Prometheus HA improvements.

raj.patel: noted follow-ups: 1) add alert when metrics-adapter sees >10% 5m error rate, 2) increase Prometheus retention/oom protection, 3) run load test to validate HPA.maxReplicas bounds.

oncall-sre: oncall handoff at 02:00 UTC to dan.infra for night watch. I'll update incident channel with timeline and next steps.

alice.chen: thanks team. I'll draft customer-facing incident summary and notify support. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident marked P1 -> mitigated. Please add postmortem link when ready.
